archetypes.name: slot-attribution
archetypes.rationale: Fixed-slot vote attribution is the highest-risk contract change.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review code-review tally and dispatch paths for canonical v1/v2/v3 preservation. Focus on failed middle slots, parse-rate removal, and empty placeholder handling. Verify votes cannot shift between archetype columns. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: fallback-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Cursor-vs-Claude fallback branching spans Python and Bash callers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review dispatch_voters and review-core integration for Cursor-available and Cursor-unavailable paths. Confirm Claude is not launched when Cursor is available, Codex is never a code-review voter, and fallback quorum is a single substantive judge. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
